headers.interpretation: A1 is the catalog label for the first surviving ciphertext block; no printed 1 TL appears. The second block is explicitly 2 TL. The beginning-lost note and unknown station are retained, but the 346-slot body already matches its advertised length; no additional lost prefix is modeled.

verbatim: B) LP v OSM (12.49 a.m., October 4th)
headers.interpretation: The two header times are retained without an asserted send/receive chronology. This radio report is separate from the oil inquiry.

p64_A1.sensitivity_rule: An additional variant masks all three faded primary glyphs without changing their slots or the baseline literal transcription.

p64_A2.parsing_rule: Each parenthesized X is one printed coordinate slot. The parentheses are retained in source_rows as qualification punctuation, not counted as cipher coordinates. The main stream accepts both printed X labels; all three nonempty mask subsets are retained as sensitivity variants.
p64_A2.numeric_limit: Masking source 353 leaves reference position 175 in 57DSTU; a separate decimal-only interpretation reduces this to 5 or 7, rather than selecting the printed 5.

paper.title: Deciphering ADFGVX messages from the Eastern Front of World War I
paper.explicit_prior_oil_body: The paper publishes both p64 A parts, the oil-stock/production inquiry and its Hagelin/Nobel interpretation. Full prior body credit is retained.
paper.identity_limit: The paper proposes Karl Wilhelm Hagelin, while noting uncertainty about the role of the name in the message. This edition identifies the literal HAGELIN string, not an independently verified individual or sender.
paper.native_wording_difference: The paper prints DRINGENDE and BETREFFEND in its spaced reconstruction. The native source edition retains DRINGENE and BETREFFEN; no extra D is supplied.

dissertation.author: George Lasry
dissertation.result: Repeats the p64 A Hagelin/Nobel body and interpretation.

prior_attribution_check.radio_body_scope: A bounded search for Damascus/Damaskus/Aleppo and p64 B located no explicit separate radio-body discussion in the paper, dissertation text or cached 2017 comments. This negative result is not a priority claim.

limits: The names BENEDIKT,ATOM,NOBEL and HAGELIN are presented with their source-level qualification; ATOM is not silently expanded to a different place.

The radio report retains literal 1X10, ?600, 70 and 30056. If the unknown in ?600 is required to be a decimal digit, its domain 1EKLOS leaves only 1; that is an optional field-type interpretation, not a baseline fill.
No model changes the complete published square or any numeral assignment.
Parenthesis and faded-glyph sensitivity variants are alternatives for the same physical records, not extra catalog entries.
